exceptions.rationale: Torch 2.11.0 requires setuptools<82. The advisory affects Unicode-normalization handling while building source distributions on macOS; Facetorch's official platform and release builders are Linux.
mitigations: Facetorch source distributions use an isolated setuptools>=83 build backend.
Release jobs reject non-Linux production targets.
The runtime environment does not invoke setuptools to build source distributions.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove when a validated Torch 2.11 patch no longer requires vulnerable setuptools, or drop the cohort.

exceptions.rationale: The local denial-of-service advisory affects torch.nn.functional.ctc_loss. Facetorch does not call that API; Torch 2.6 remains the validated CUDA 12.4 production cohort while newer intermediate Torch lines are unsupported.
mitigations: Release contracts reject any Facetorch production-source use of ctc_loss while this exception exists.
Model inputs are selected from digest-pinned manifest entries and are not passed to the affected API.
The exception is restricted to the exact Torch 2.6 CPU and CUDA 12.4 release profiles.
exceptions.upstream_constraint: The first patched Torch line is 2.8, which is not a validated Facetorch cohort.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove when Torch 2.6 is dropped, an upstream backport is validated, or a replacement CUDA 12.4-compatible cohort is released.
